note: Errata 29. Where each item's icon sits in the sheet. Declared here rather than computed in two places, for the same reason the room idle sheets are: the builder and the engine must not be able to disagree about a rectangle. check-item-names reads the PNG itself and fails if two of these cells are pixel-identical -- an icon nobody can tell from another icon is the running gag dying quietly, which is what that check has always existed to stop.
